==Description==
'''Warm Land''' is an easy [[PVP]] [[Maps|map]] that also appeared in the [[PVP Test]].

==Design & Path==
'''Warm Land''' was a map stylized after classic Roblox. It consisted of two mountains located in a desert. On these mountains, there were multiple cliffs and smaller rocks scattered around the ground. There were also multiple cacti, skeleton bones and barrels placed on the ground. The mountains also contain a few structures, these being windmills and a small house. A wooden bridge connected both mountains.

The path started and ended at one side of the map. The path itself resembled a wrench or a heart.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Warm Land}}

==Strategy==
*Towers should be placed around the top curve of the map, to ensure the path per range space is maximized, especially towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]].
**Towers like [[Sledger]], [[Brawler]], [[Warden]] and [[Gladiator]] should be placed on the corners of the path.
*Due to the centralized nature of this map, most towers should be placed around the middle, especially [[DJ Booth]].
*The cliff spot on the center of the map should be the one used for all cliff towers, as the other cliff spots remain too distant from appropriate ground spots to be reliable.

==Trivia==
*The intermission lobby listed SorenDerg as one of the creators. However, SorenDerg was not actually involved in creating this map and has not been active in the Tower Defense Simulator community since early 2023.
*'''Warm Land''' is the only 2025 PVP Testing map to not have a path that loops on itself.
*'''Warm Land''' is the finished version of [[PVP_5]].
